The call changes no node data, so the badges are identical; it only records a display preference, shown as a tag above each graph that reads display: None before and display: name, in the accent color, after." width="100%"} Records the name of a node attribute as the graph's display preference, i.e., the attribute meant to be shown for each node in place of its ID when the graph is rendered. Only this preference is stored; no node data is read, created, or changed, and the attribute name is not validated against the nodes. The call is also logged in the graph's recorded step history. `plot()` uses this attribute for its node text when `label_by=` isn't given. As in `label_by=`, `"label"` and `"id"` are also accepted, and nodes lacking the attribute show their ID. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the node attribute to display (e.g., `"label"` or `"name"`). Any string is accepted here; `plot()` raises if no node has that attribute. If `None` (the default), the preference is cleared, which means node IDs are shown. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Setting the display attribute returns the graph itself, so it can sit in the middle of a method chain. The node data is unchanged afterward: ::: {#b440b4ee .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec G = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice", age=30) .add_node(label="Bob", age=25) .add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob") .set_node_attr_to_display(attr="age") ) G.get_node_attrs("age") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {2: 25, 1: 30} ``` ::: ::: Passing `None` clears the preference again: ::: {#a4b41826 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} G.set_node_attr_to_display(attr=None) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
